nodes.name: Daily Monitoring Schedule
nodes.notes: Triggers the brand monitoring workflow daily at 8:00 AM UTC. Can be customized per brand requirements.

nodes.name: Workflow Variables
nodes.notes: Configuration variables for brand monitoring. Customize these values for different brands and monitoring requirements.

nodes.name: Platform Router
nodes.notes: Routes the workflow to enabled social media platforms based on configuration.

nodes.name: Instagram Data Collection
nodes.notes: Collects Instagram posts, engagement metrics, and profile data using Instagram Basic Display API.

nodes.name: Facebook Data Collection
nodes.notes: Collects Facebook posts, engagement metrics including likes, comments, shares, and reactions.

nodes.name: Twitter/X Data Collection
nodes.notes: Collects tweets and engagement metrics using Twitter API v2, including mentions and brand-related content.

nodes.name: LinkedIn Data Collection
nodes.notes: Collects LinkedIn company posts and engagement metrics for professional brand presence monitoring.

nodes.name: TikTok Data Collection
nodes.notes: Collects TikTok videos and engagement metrics related to brand mentions and keywords.

nodes.name: YouTube Data Collection
nodes.notes: Collects YouTube videos and channel metrics related to brand content and mentions.

nodes.name: Data Processing & Metrics
nodes.notes: Processes raw social media data, calculates standardized metrics (engagement rate, reach, performance scores), and normalizes data structure across platforms.

nodes.name: Sentiment Analysis Check
nodes.notes: Checks if sentiment analysis is enabled in the workflow configuration.

values.content: You are an expert brand analyst specializing in social media sentiment analysis and competitive intelligence. Analyze the provided social media data and provide comprehensive insights including sentiment analysis, performance trends, competitive positioning, and actionable recommendations.

=Analyze the following brand social media data and provide insights:

Brand: {{ $('Workflow Variables').first().json.brand_name }}
Platforms: {{ $('Workflow Variables').first().json.platforms_enabled }}
Data Period: Last {{ $('Workflow Variables').first().json.days_to_analyze }} days

Social Media Data:
{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}

Please provide analysis in the following structure:
1. Overall Sentiment Analysis (positive, negative, neutral percentages)
2. Platform Performance Comparison
3. Top Performing Content Analysis
4. Engagement Trends and Patterns
5. Competitive Insights (if competitive data available)
6. Growth Opportunities and Recommendations
7. Risk Areas and Concerns
8. Key Performance Indicators Summary

Format the response as structured JSON for easy parsing and database storage.

nodes.name: AI Sentiment & Performance Analysis
nodes.notes: Uses GPT-4 to perform comprehensive sentiment analysis, competitive intelligence, and provide actionable insights for brand digital presence.

nodes.name: Competitive Analysis
nodes.notes: Performs competitive analysis comparing brand performance against configured competitors, identifying market position, opportunities, and threats.

nodes.name: Report Generator
nodes.notes: Generates comprehensive brand monitoring reports with executive summary, platform performance, AI insights, recommendations, and action items.

nodes.name: Notion Database Storage
nodes.notes: Stores the comprehensive brand monitoring report in Notion database with structured fields for easy analysis and tracking.

nodes.name: Alert Conditions
nodes.notes: Checks conditions for sending email alerts based on performance thresholds and configuration settings.

parameters.subject: =Brand Performance Alert: {{ $('Workflow Variables').first().json.brand_name }}

nodes.name: Email Alert System
nodes.notes: Sends email alerts when performance falls below thresholds, including detailed report and action items.

nodes.name: Error Handling & Logging
nodes.notes: Handles errors, warnings, and logging throughout the workflow execution. Provides system health monitoring and next execution planning.

nodes.name: Execution Logging
nodes.notes: Stores workflow execution logs, errors, warnings, and system health metrics in Notion for monitoring and troubleshooting.
